package techversion

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// ListTechVersions lists tech versions with pagination.
type ListTechVersions struct {
	TechVersions repository.TechVersionRepository
}

// Handle returns tech version list.
func (uc ListTechVersions) Handle(ctx context.Context, filter filters.TechVersionFilters) ([]domain.TechVersion, int, error) {
	return uc.TechVersions.List(ctx, filter)
}
